args: b=code-reality-mcp; want=0.11.0; if [ "$CODE_REALITY_BOOTSTRAP" != off ]; then uv_cmd="$(command -v uv 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$uv_cmd" ] || uv_cmd="$HOME/.local/bin/uv"; if [ -x "$uv_cmd" ]; then ub="$("$uv_cmd" tool dir --bin 2>/dev/null)" || { echo "[BOOTSTRAP] cannot resolve uv tool bin dir - upgrade uv (uv tool dir --bin unsupported)" >&2; exit 127; }; [ -n "$ub" ] || { echo "[BOOTSTRAP] uv tool bin dir is empty" >&2; exit 127; }; pinned(){ x="$1"; [ -x "$ub/$x" ] || return 1; case "$("$ub/$x" --version 2>/dev/null)" in "$want"|"$want+"*) return 0;; *) return 1;; esac; }; all_pinned(){ pinned code-reality-mcp && pinned code-reality-lsp-bridge && pinned pyrefly-index; }; if all_pinned; then exec "$ub/$b" --stdio; fi; echo "[BOOTSTRAP] installing code-reality $want via uv (consumer face stale or missing)" >&2; "$uv_cmd" tool install --force "code-reality==$want" >&2 && "$uv_cmd" tool install --force "code-reality-lsp-bridge==$want" >&2 && "$uv_cmd" tool install --force "pyrefly-producer==$want" >&2 || { echo "[BOOTSTRAP] install $want failed - check network and retry next session" >&2; exit 127; }; if all_pinned; then exec "$ub/$b" --stdio; fi; bad=""; for x in code-reality-mcp code-reality-lsp-bridge pyrefly-index; do pinned "$x" || bad="$bad $x"; done; echo "[BOOTSTRAP] post-install verification failed - still stale or missing:$bad (want $want in $ub)" >&2; exit 127; fi; echo "[BOOTSTRAP] uv not found on PATH or at ~/.local/bin - install it first: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh (dev override: CODE_REALITY_BOOTSTRAP=off)" >&2; exit 127; fi; command -v "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$b" --stdio; for d in "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.cargo/bin"; do [ -x "$d/$b" ] && exec "$d/$b" --stdio; done; echo "[BOOTSTRAP] $b not found (bootstrap off, nothing resolves)" >&2; exit 127
